activity_summary: You had come by Ludgate, the Strand, Knightsbridge and Kensington, and then by a lane onto the Uxbridge way. The lane cost a mile. A strap rubbed, and the cheese was still shut.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke while walking, and did not stop except to set the strap.

facets.activity: Said the lane cost a mile and set the strap

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A lane after that, north, onto the Uxbridge way
